metadata.title: Linux Fundamentals
metadata.description: Start from zero. Read files, move around the filesystem, and capture your first flags in your own private Linux terminal.

chapters.title: Beginner: first steps
chapters.description: Get comfortable typing commands. You will read files, ask the system who you are, and work out where you are standing in the filesystem.
chapters.summary: Get comfortable typing commands. You will read files, ask the system who you are, and work out where you are standing in the filesystem.
skills: Run a command and read its output
Check your identity with whoami and id
Find your location with pwd and list files with ls (including hidden ones)

exercises.title: First contact: read your dispatch
exercises.description: Read dispatch.txt in your home directory, copy the CYBER{...} flag, and submit it below.

exercises.title: Know your operator
exercises.description: Run whoami and id. Then read /home/user/operator.txt to collect your dispatch.

exercises.title: Your place in the tree
exercises.description: Inspect your location with pwd. Read coordinates.txt from that location.

exercises.title: The dispatch shelf
exercises.description: Locate the hidden dispatch in your home folder and read it.

chapters.title: Beginner: paths and discovery
chapters.description: Move around the filesystem with confidence. Paths are how every Linux tool finds things, so this chapter makes absolute and relative paths second nature.
chapters.summary: Move around the filesystem with confidence. Paths are how every Linux tool finds things, so this chapter makes absolute and relative paths second nature.
skills: Change directories with cd (and jump back with cd -)
Read files anywhere using absolute paths
Use the built-in manual with man and help

exercises.title: Walk to the relay
exercises.description: Navigate into stations/relay and read message.txt, then return home.

exercises.title: Ask the manual
exercises.description: Read man ls, then locate the hidden file inside /opt/academy/helpdesk.

chapters.title: Beginner: files and checkpoint
chapters.description: Change things, not just read them. You will handle awkward filenames, copy and rename files, then prove it all in the beginner checkpoint.
chapters.summary: Change things, not just read them. You will handle awkward filenames, copy and rename files, then prove it all in the beginner checkpoint.
skills: Copy files with cp and rename them with mv
Combine everything to solve a multi-step checkpoint

exercises.title: Names with spaces
exercises.description: Read the file named shift notes.txt.

exercises.title: Copy a field report
exercises.description: Create backup and copy report.txt to backup/report.txt. The reward file appears when the backup contains the original text.

exercises.title: Rename the incoming report
exercises.description: Rename incoming.txt to approved.txt without changing its content.

exercises.title: Beginner checkpoint: locate the parcel
exercises.description: Find the hidden parcel in /opt/academy/relay/archive and submit its flag.
